project: Automatos AI Platform — PRD-151 Storage Decoupling (One S3 Path, MinIO Local Default)
description:
Make object storage pluggable with MinIO as the local/OSS default by centralizing every S3 client behind ONE factory (orchestrator/core/storage/s3.py) that honors S3_ENDPOINT_URL / S3_PUBLIC_ENDPOINT_URL / S3_USE_PATH_STYLE from config.py (knob names must match envs/api.defaults:55-61 which already documents them). This is NOT a StorageProvider abstraction — the S3 API is the interface; the seam is configuration (PRD-151 §1, §7). STACKING: branch from the PRD-150 tip; assume auth decoupling (AuthProvider, no Clerk leakage) is already done — do not touch core/auth. METHOD: (1) add config knobs + factory with get_s3_client()/get_s3_public_client()/is_storage_configured()/StorageNotConfigured/ensure_bucket(); (2) add the MinIO CI lane + skip-when-unconfigured integration tests; (3) mechanically repoint all 16 verified boto3 S3 call sites (the PRD's table missed three: api/workflow_recipes.py:1145-1160, modules/documents/generation_service.py:543-575, api/documents.py:1723-1730 — they are in scope); (4) make DocumentManager and S3VectorsBackend clients lazy (FR-4: importing/constructing managers never does network I/O); (5) DELETE the three bespoke fallbacks (LocalStorageService, LocalImageStore, attachments local-path branch) in the same story that lands their MinIO regression tests — no shims, no _legacy; (6) presigned URLs use the public endpoint, attachments get a tag-filtered 7-day lifecycle applied ONLY to buckets the factory itself creates; (7) unconfigured storage fails with ONE typed exception mapped to HTTP 503. HARD CONSTRAINTS: zero behavioral change for SaaS when S3_ENDPOINT_URL is unset (G5) — ensure_bucket is a NO-OP on AWS and lifecycle rules are never applied to pre-existing buckets; no os.getenv outside config.py; boto3.client may survive only in core/storage/s3.py, backends/s3_vectors_backend.py (SaaS-only s3vectors, lazy), core/llm/clients/bedrock_client.py (bedrock-runtime, NOT storage — leave alone), and scripts/recreate_s3_index.py (s3vectors ops script). OUT OF SCOPE: docker-compose MinIO service definition (PRD-153), Qdrant/field-memory, migrating AWS data, S3 Vectors local emulation, marketplace content strategy, renaming RECIPE_LOG_S3_BUCKET's prod default (PRD Q3 — leave "automatos-ai"). ENVIRONMENT FACTS verified 2026-06-09: local pytest = `cd orchestrator && python3 -m pytest ...` (pytest.ini sets pythonpath=., testpaths=tests; pytest-timeout works); Docker daemon was DOWN on this machine, so MinIO integration tests must auto-skip when config.S3_ENDPOINT_URL is empty and the live lane is proven in GitHub CI (.github/workflows/test.yml) after Gerard pushes — the loop never pushes. Canonical terms in any user-facing copy: Playbook (not Recipe), Mission, Deliverable.

VERIFIER AMENDMENTS (BINDING — adversarial re-verification 2026-06-09; these OVERRIDE story text where they conflict):
1. S9 scope CORRECTED: broad `except Exception` blocks swallow StorageNotConfigured before any app-level handler, so S9 also owns: api/attachments.py (~105-107 catch -> 500 'Upload failed': re-raise StorageNotConfigured/HTTPException so it maps to 503), api/documents.py upload (~253 sets status=failed + returns 200; ~266 -> 500: let StorageNotConfigured propagate to 503), api/admin_plugins.py (~197-200 500 catch: same fix). api/marketplace_plugins.py ~340-345 silent manifest degrade is CORRECT (best-effort surface) — leave silent. Rule: API upload surfaces 503; best-effort surfaces (step-log upload, purge wipe, generation upload, legacy download fallback, result_formatter) keep degrading silently.
2. Protected baseline counts: config suites = 56 tests on main (NOT 68); the four-suite protected total of 77 is correct.
3. Any HEAD~1-based AC: diff against $(git merge-base HEAD ralph/prd-150-auth-decoupling) instead; 'net LOC reduction' is proven by the fallbacks-deleted grep, not by diffstat interpretation.
4. S8's '(code-review check: ...)' clause is prose — the offline mock test is the verification.
5. This branch stacks on the PRD-150 tip created TONIGHT: every line number in this map was verified on MAIN, and services/workspace_purge.py in particular is rewritten by PRD-150 — ALWAYS re-locate by content (grep), never edit by line number.

userStories.title: Storage config knobs + the one S3 client factory
userStories.description: Create the seam (PRD US-001+US-002). TDD: write orchestrator/tests/test_storage_factory.py FIRST. (a) In orchestrator/config.py, next to the existing S3 section (S3_DOCUMENTS_BUCKET is at line ~640, AWS_* at ~628-630), add three knobs read via the existing os.getenv pattern: S3_ENDPOINT_URL (default ""), S3_PUBLIC_ENDPOINT_URL (default ""), S3_USE_PATH_STYLE (raw string, default "" meaning auto). Names MUST match envs/api.defaults lines 55-61 exactly. (b) NEW package orchestrator/core/storage/ with s3.py exposing: get_s3_client() — memoized per process, builds boto3.client("s3", endpoint_url=config.S3_ENDPOINT_URL or None, region_name=config.AWS_REGION or "us-east-1", aws creds from config when set, config=BotoConfig(signature_version="v4", retries={max_attempts:3, mode:"adaptive"}, s3={"addressing_style": "path" if path-style else "virtual"})) where path-style = S3_USE_PATH_STYLE truthy, auto-true when S3_ENDPOINT_URL set, and addressing_style is left at boto default ("auto") when on AWS so SaaS calls are byte-identical (G5); get_s3_public_client() — same but endpoint_url=S3_PUBLIC_ENDPOINT_URL, falling back to get_s3_client() when unset (used ONLY for generate_presigned_url); is_storage_configured() -> bool (true when S3_ENDPOINT_URL set OR both AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY set); class StorageNotConfigured(Exception) defaulting to the exact G3 message "object storage not configured — set S3_ENDPOINT_URL (local/MinIO) or AWS credentials"; get_s3_client() raises StorageNotConfigured when not configured; ensure_bucket(name) — idempotent head_bucket/create_bucket memoized per bucket name per process, and a NO-OP returning False when config.S3_ENDPOINT_URL is empty (AWS prod buckets pre-exist; G5 — never create/mutate buckets on AWS); reset_storage_clients() clearing all memos (tests + config reload). No network I/O at import (FR-4); boto3 client CONSTRUCTION is offline so unit tests can assert client.meta.endpoint_url and client.meta.config.s3["addressing_style"] without mocks; monkeypatch config attributes (never os.environ) and call reset_storage_clients() around each test. Test cases: endpoint wired; path-style auto-on with endpoint; path-style absent/auto on AWS; public client fallback; unconfigured raises StorageNotConfigured with the G3 text; memoization returns same object; reset clears; ensure_bucket no-ops (False, zero client calls — use a MagicMock client via monkeypatching get_s3_client) when endpoint unset, and head/create exactly once across two calls when endpoint set. No os.getenv anywhere in core/storage/.

userStories.title: Presigned public-endpoint guarantees + attachments 7-day lifecycle
userStories.description: PRD US-006/US-007/US-008. The presign call sites were repointed to get_s3_public_client() in S3/S4/S7; this story proves and completes the local semantics. (a) In orchestrator/core/storage/s3.py extend ensure_bucket(name, lifecycle_days: int | None = None, lifecycle_tag: tuple[str,str] | None = None): when it CREATES a bucket (MinIO bootstrap only — verified no-op on AWS) and lifecycle_days is given, put_bucket_lifecycle_configuration with an Expiration rule filtered on the tag (e.g. ('ephemeral','true')); NEVER apply lifecycle to a bucket that already existed (G5 — mutating prod AWS bucket config is forbidden; PRD-127's AWS rule is managed out-of-band). (b) orchestrator/modules/attachments/store.py: attachments share S3_DOCUMENTS_BUCKET under workspaces/{ws}/ephemeral-attachments/ — a bucket-wide or workspaces/-prefix rule would delete real documents, so prefix filtering CANNOT work: put() adds Tagging="ephemeral=true" to put_object, and the store's first write calls ensure_bucket(bucket, lifecycle_days=7, lifecycle_tag=("ephemeral","true")). userStories.title: Failure-mode contract: one 503, non-storage features untouched
userStories.description: PRD US-010 + G3 + FR-5. (a) orchestrator/main.py: register an exception handler mapping StorageNotConfigured → JSONResponse 503 {"detail": "object storage not configured — set S3_ENDPOINT_URL (local/MinIO) or AWS credentials"} following the existing pattern (app.add_exception_handler(RateLimitExceeded, ...) at main.py:851; the broad @app.exception_handler(Exception) at :1476 must NOT swallow it first — register the typed handler so FastAPI dispatches on the specific class). Import from core.storage.s3. (b) Audit the surfaces that intentionally degrade instead of 503 and keep them degrading (these catch broadly today and must continue to): playbook step-log upload (api/recipe_executor.py returns None), step-log fetch already raises HTTPException, workspace purge skips S3 wipe, modules/documents/generation_service._upload_to_s3 returns None (falls back to local serving), api/documents.py download falls through to legacy local file serving, result_formatter returns "". The 503 path is for direct storage features: document upload (api/documents.py upload route), attachments upload (api/attachments.py), marketplace plugin install/upload (api/marketplace_plugins.py / admin_plugins.py — these construct MarketplaceS3Service() inside endpoints so the exception propagates), image retrieval (api/generated_images.py). (c) TDD: NEW orchestrator/tests/test_storage_failure_modes.py using fastapi.testclient against the relevant routers (import the app or build a minimal app mounting the router + the handler — follow the pattern of existing tests/api/test_deliverables_api.py): with config storage attrs monkeypatched empty + reset_storage_clients(), document upload returns 503 with the exact G3 message substring "object storage not configured"; attachments upload returns 503; /health (or another storage-free endpoint) still 200. IMPORTANT: monkeypatch config attributes, never ambient env — CI now exports S3_ENDPOINT_URL globally (S2) and tests must not depend on it being unset.
